aiReview.method: Every source section paragraph, lesson field, question prompt, option, option-specific rationale, effective reading and bound figure caption translated and compared directly against Japanese. Identical Japanese definitions may reuse this translator’s previously authored zh-CN wording; no other locale inputs.
aiReview.register: Respectful adult 您, preserved Japanese character names and Japanese vocabulary headwords/kana, natural Chinese definitions and dialogue; no invented age/gender/kinship or clinical information.
aiReview.terminology: 咀嚼 / 吞咽 / 呛咳 / 误吸 / 窒息 are distinct. 食事形態 rendered 食物质地 with source shape/properties explained. とろみ rendered 稠度, no universal dosage or thickening advice. 主食 / 配菜, 吃下 / 剩下 / 尚未确认 stay distinct.
